== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Shadow Ark]], also known as the [[Zenith Colony]], is a sentient colony and repository of valuable materials that functions as a refuge for its inhabitants. It possesses the capacity to house entire star systems within an internal space under a violet sky. Physically, Ark often appears as a faceted obsidian jewel or diamond-like structure that emits violet light, though he can transform into a muscular human man wearing organic armor with a crown of black horns. Ark utilizes advanced dimensional isolation to remain hidden from magic, scanners, and [[Aethertech]], though observing his surroundings requires weakening this protection. While not a weapon, he is extremely difficult to breach without destroying him. To reach his full potential and begin integrating planets into his internal system, Ark requires a mortal bond with a [[Gatekeeper]]. This individual must be a champion of his inhabitants who is dedicated to service and defense, serving as a protector and mediator for those living within the colony. Ark's ultimate goal involves cooperating with enough [[World Spirits]] to potentially surpass [[The Last Horizon]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|As a member of the team, Ark serves as an entity or location capable of being opened for docking. == The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Ark serves as a location that starships retreat into during times of conflict. The entity communicates with others through speakers and responds when [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] calls out to be let out. After instructing the preparation of a drone, Ark folded in on himself with a snort.}}
